name: What are popular design trends for modern bathroom remodels?

mainEntity.name: What are popular design trends for modern bathroom remodels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Current trends for modern bathroom remodels often include minimalist aesthetics, natural materials like wood and stone, and smart technology integrations. Freestanding tubs, walk-in showers with linear drains, and frameless glass enclosures are popular choices. Matte black or brushed gold fixtures are trending, as are textured tiles and mood lighting. Incorporating sustainable elements and maximizing storage solutions are also key aspects of contemporary design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular trends include minimalist designs, natural materials, smart technology, walk-in showers, freestanding tubs, and matte black or brushed gold fixtures.
